description:
Is each citation in an output supported by its source? Extracts, fetches (opt-in, SSRF-guarded) and judges on your key.

What it does. Fetches only with allow_fetch or IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH=1, blocking private addresses. One judge call per resolved citation, capped by max_cost_usd_total; overall_score is supported / judged, null when none was judged. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. With no citations (evaluate_output). Without IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY.

Returns. JSON: id, trace_id, overall_score, passed, verdict, total_unsupported, total_citations_found, total_resolved, total_judged, total_supported, total_cost_usd, citations.

Errors. IRIS_JUDGE_NOT_ENABLED, IRIS_JUDGE_UNKNOWN_MODEL, IRIS_UNKNOWN_TRACE (before any spend); IRIS_JUDGE_FAILED when every judge call failed. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. evaluate_with_llm_judge — general semantic scoring; evaluate_output — the free deterministic path.

allow_fetch.description: Permit outbound HTTP to resolve URLs/DOIs. Defaults to IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH=1; false otherwise. SSRF-guarded regardless.

domain_allowlist.description: Restrict fetches to hostnames in this list (suffix match allowed). Merged with IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS env.

max_citations.description: Max citations to verify (extras skipped, not errored); default 20, at most 50

max_cost_usd_total.description: Cap TOTAL judge cost across all citations in this call; default 1.00 USD — the pipeline stops when the next call would exceed it

model.description: Judge model for per-citation verification. Supported: anthropic = claude-fable-5-1 | claude-opus-5 | claude-sonnet-5 (and the priced 4.x line); openai = gpt-5 | gpt-5-mini | gpt-4.1-mini (and the priced 4o, o3/o4 and retired o1 ids); an unknown id is refused with the full priced list.

output.description: The agent output containing citations to verify

trace_id.description: Link verification result to a stored trace (id from log_trace / get_traces); an unknown id is rejected before any fetch or judge call

name: verify_citations
title: Verify Citations
